description: This is a unit test class for the NullFeature class in the Eclipse Ditto project, testing equality, immutability, null handling, and JSON output.

classes.name: NullFeatureTest
classes.description: Unit test class for NullFeature, testing correctness and constraints

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that NullFeature correctly implements equals and hashCode via EqualsVerifier

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that NullFeature instances are immutable and that related classes are also immutable

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Tests that creating NullFeature with null throws NullPointerException

methods.name: createInstanceReturnsTheExpectedJson
methods.description: Tests that NullFeature returns 'null' as JSON string and has empty properties when created with a valid ID
